title: D-045 A1 wave 1: R1+R2 series height/setback draft rule families (numeric-limit districts, R5-pilot discipline)
objective: Extract, as draft (needs_review) rule families in the existing rules engine/DSL, the CURRENT effective height & setback regulations for the R1 and R2 series districts - every variant a real lot can carry (e.g. R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2, R2A, R2X; the authoritative variant list comes from the official ZR source, never assumed), each variant scoped SEPARATELY with no cross-variant defaults. Model base height, building height, street wall, setback, and perimeter-wall constraints (where the source defines them) as SEPARATE typed min/max constraints exactly per the accepted M4-T006 R5 pilot; every constraint records exact ZR section/clause + amendment/effective dates + source snapshot id+hash + precise applicability; fail-closed on any missing/ambiguous source (a typed gap, never a guessed number); never label any output a buildable envelope, feasible building, or massing. These families were chosen as A1 wave 1 because their limits are numeric per-district (no sky-exposure-plane / street-width dependency), keeping the A2 geometry-mechanics dependency out of this packet per D-045-R008 one-family-at-a-time sequencing.
business_reason: D-045-R001 (owner 2026-09-13) authorizes the full A1 height/setback coverage beyond the R5 pilot; R1+R2 is the lowest-complexity family, proving the campaign cadence without touching the A2 dependency.
inputs: project-control/tasks/M4-T006.json + project-control/reports/M4-T006-producer-report.md + M4-T006-input-readiness-matrix.md + M4-T006-source-capture.md (THE pilot discipline this packet clones: per-variant separation, typed min/max constraints, snapshot+hash provenance, fail-closed gaps, NC negative controls, needs_review posture)
services/api/app/rules/rulesets/ (the accepted R5 height/setback + FAR ruleset files as concrete DSL examples - READ-ONLY; new files only)
services/api/app/rules/ (the deterministic engine + DSL schemas - engine is READ-ONLY; schema extension ONLY if a genuinely new constraint shape is required, additive-only)

services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/ + the sync_zr_snapshots mechanism (the byte-identical, hash-guarded official-text snapshot pattern; new R1/R2-series ZR section snapshots enter through THIS mechanism only)
docs/MVP_ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QA.md Part 4, group A1 rows (the gap-list scope this wave discharges for R1+R2)
project-control/directives/D-045-citywide-rule-coverage/requirements.json (R001 the A1 obligation; R008 one-family-at-a-time; R009 preservation: DRAFT-until-G6, no compliance declarations)

acceptance_scenarios.input: the official ZR text snapshots for the R1- and R2-series height/setback sections
acceptance_scenarios.expected: every variant the official source defines (authoritative enumeration recorded with its source anchor in the source-capture report) gets its OWN scoped constraints; every constraint value carries exact ZR section/clause, amendment/effective date, and snapshot id+hash; no value exists without a snapshot the hash guard verifies

base height, building height, street wall, setback, and perimeter-wall constraints are SEPARATE typed constraints preserving min AND max where the source distinguishes them (never collapsed into one number); units explicit; the DSL schema unchanged unless a genuinely new shape required an additive-only extension justified in the report

acceptance_scenarios.input: a section the source leaves ambiguous or a variant/condition the wave does not cover
acceptance_scenarios.expected: a typed, provenance-carrying gap outcome (never a guessed or interpolated number, never a silent omission); districts outside R1/R2 series evaluate as not-covered by these rulesets; tests prove both behaviors

acceptance_scenarios.input: the NC pattern from the R5 pilot applied to this family
acceptance_scenarios.expected: wrong-district inputs match nothing; cross-variant isolation proven (an R2A value never leaks into R2X); superseded/older text is not used (effective-date discipline tested); mutation-style checks show each constraint's test actually binds its value

acceptance_scenarios.input: grep + status fields over the new rulesets and any rendered strings
acceptance_scenarios.expected: every rule is status needs_review (DRAFT); no output or test labels anything a buildable envelope / feasible building / massing / compliance determination; D-045-R009 preserved verbatim (G6 remains the only path past needs_review)

acceptance_scenarios.input: the full rules suite + engine determinism checks + modularity + CI on the pushed head
acceptance_scenarios.expected: ALL existing rules tests pass unchanged; the engine is untouched (forbidden); evaluation is deterministic across runs; python tools/modularity_check.py --check EXIT 0; the api CI job green at the frozen candidate

risks: SOURCE AVAILABILITY: if a needed official ZR section snapshot is absent from the corpus and cannot be captured through the established snapshot mechanism from the producer sandbox, submit BLOCKED naming the exact sections - NEVER transcribe from memory or a secondary source (permanent principle 3)

the R1/R2 series may carry conditional provisions that reference geometry-dependent mechanics (A2 territory) - such provisions are recorded as typed fail-closed gaps citing the section, NOT implemented in this wave (D-045-R008 sequencing)
cross-variant leakage is the family's chief modeling hazard (R2A/R2X contextual-style caps differ from R2) - per-variant scoping with isolation tests is mandatory, no shared defaults
Python 3.12 repo vs 3.11 sandbox (M2-T015 pattern): if pytest cannot collect locally, rely on CI evidence and disclose
amendment currency: the extraction must state WHICH text version each snapshot captures and its effective date; a superseded value with a newer amendment in force is a defect
path_notes: PILOT-CLONE DISCIPLINE: this packet intentionally mirrors accepted M4-T006 (same producer role, gates, review roster, path shape) so the campaign cadence is provable one family at a time (D-045-R008). ENGINE READ-ONLY: rulesets are data; the engine/evaluator are forbidden paths - a rule family that seems to need engine changes is a BLOCKED submission, not an engine edit. SNAPSHOTS: official text enters only via the established hash-guarded snapshot mechanism; the source-capture report records URL + retrieval date + hash for every snapshot. DRAFT-UNTIL-G6 (D-045-R009 / Section 20): nothing in this task moves any rule past needs_review. WORKTREE: producer works in its own worktree reset to the task base on candidate/D-024-mrl-option-b; primary checkout is orchestrator-only.
documented_test_commands: CI 'api' job (ruff + pytest) on the pushed head - the executable authority where the local 3.11 sandbox cannot collect (M2-T015 pattern)
